message: The ember target does not support generic-components: Slot forwarding, transitions, generic components and async setup are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.

The angular target does not support generic-slot-props: Angular infers a component's type parameter from its inputs alone, and a slot's directive cannot infer it, so a scoped slot's context takes the parameter's constraint, where the other targets type the consumer's fill by the type argument (ADR-0068).
The ember target does not support generic-slot-props: Slot forwarding, transitions, generic components and async setup are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.
